messages:
dmitri: Heads up — Solstice (vendor) flagged a Q3 invoice. They were on a $10k/mo retainer but ran an integration test that spiked usage to ~26k for a short window. They're asking for a prorated credit + a goodwill adjustment. Attaching invoice lines.

sam: Can you paste the invoice/usage lines? I need the invoice id and daily usage breakdown to compute the prorate. Also who owns approval for >$5k credits?

dmitri: Invoice INV-2025-3092. Usage lines: 
```
date,feature,tokens,cost
2025-08-03,api-gen,1,2000
2025-08-04,api-gen,1,8000
2025-08-05,api-gen,1,16000
```
Rough calc: billed $28k usage on top of $10k retainer = $38k total for the period. They think a 2-week integration spike should be prorated to ~$8k — asking for a $30k credit overall.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-3092 found. Current balance: $38,000. Credit memos allowed up to $10,000 without manager approval.

sam: Ok. Proposal: (1) prorate the retainer for the spike window (~$8k) and (2) issue a capped goodwill credit of $5k (manager approval required for >$10k). That nets $13k credit. @leo, can you sign off on a $13k manual adjustment?

maya: Ops rec — apply the prorate directly to the current invoice and create a separate credit memo for the goodwill so we can track audit lines. Also request Solstice to submit a short RCA + mitigation plan for next quarter.

leo: Reviewed numbers. I'm comfortable approving $13k total (8k prorate + 5k goodwill). Use GL code 5402 and add audit note "vendor-retrocredit-aug2025".

sam: Creating credit memo and applying to INV-2025-3092 now. Will attach memo ID and accounting entry when finished.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2025-1147 for $13,000. Applied to INV-2025-3092. Audit note: "approved by leo 1768504400".

dmitri: Thanks all — forwarding to vendor and closing loop. cc @ops-partner for follow-up. :thumbsup:
